title: Admins may not see data in multiple tabs within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center
impact: Admins may not have seen data in multiple tabs within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center.

updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 apps

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 apps and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may not see data in multiple tabs within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center

User impact: Admins may not see data in multiple tabs within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center.

More info: Admins may not see data in the following locations in the Microsoft 365 apps admin center:
- Home page
- Cloud update
- Inventory 
- Security Update Status

Admins may receive an error message stating, “There was a problem retrieving data for this page. Please refresh the page or try again later.”

Current status: Our service monitors have alerted us to ongoing impact to a subset of admins who may not see data in the tabs outlined in the "More info" section of this communication within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center. We're reviewing reports of impact to further our understanding of the current impact scenario and to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Some admins may not see data in the Home page, Cloud update, Inventory, or Security update status sections in the Microsoft 365 apps admin center. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 9:30 PM UTC

Title: Admins may not see data in multiple tabs within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center

User impact: Admins may not see data in multiple tabs within the Microsoft 365 apps admin center.

More info: Admins may not see data in the following locations in the Microsoft 365 apps admin center:
- Home page
- Cloud update
- Inventory 
- Security Update Status

Admins may receive an error message stating, “There was a problem retrieving data for this page. Please refresh the page or try again later.”

Current status: After further analysis, we've isolated that impact was caused by a recent deployment to optimize Microsoft 365 apps service infrastructure that incorrectly removed the Inventory apps and Shared Apps, resulting in impact. We've added the missing applications back to affected service infrastructure and are monitoring telemetry for remediation.

Scope of impact: Some admins may not see data in the Home page, Cloud update, Inventory, or Security update status sections in the Microsoft 365 apps admin center. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Start time: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent deployment to optimize Microsoft 365 apps service infrastructure incorrectly removed the Inventory apps and Shared Apps, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 11:30 PM UTC

Final status: After further monitoring of service telemetry, we've validated that our deployment to reinstate the removed Inventory apps and Shared Apps successfully remediated impact.

Scope of impact: Some admins may not have seen data in the Home page, Cloud update, Inventory, or Security update status sections in the Microsoft 365 apps admin center. 

Start time: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC

End time: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 8:13 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent deployment to optimize Microsoft 365 apps service infrastructure incorrectly removed the Inventory apps and Shared Apps, resulting in impact.

Next steps: 
- We're analyzing the offending deployment to isolate why the potential for impact wasn't caught prior to implementation. This further analysis will help us to ensure similar impact scenarios don't occur in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
